entities.name: Madara-Edemi War
entities.description: A brutal conflict between the Madaran Empire and the rebellious Edemi Islands.

entities.name: Madara
entities.description: Land west of Jamuraa on Dominaria.

entities.name: Madaran Empire
entities.description: Empire ruled by an enigmatic Emperor, revealed to be Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Edemi Islands
entities.description: Rebellious islands resisting the empire.

entities.name: Ramses Overdark
entities.description: The imperial assassin who instigated the war.

entities.name: Emperor of Madara
entities.description: Enigmatic ruler of Madara, revealed to be Nicol Bolas.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: Elder Dragon who was the Emperor of Madara; a planeswalker.

entities.name: Tetsuo Umezawa
entities.description: Imperial champion who turned against the empire and defeated Overdark and Bolas.

entities.name: Xira Arien
entities.description: Eumidian minion of Overdark.

entities.name: Tor Wauki the Younger
entities.description: Umezawa's second-in-command.

entities.name: Ayesha Tanaka
entities.description: Artificer ally of Umezawa who mastered the magic of the Sylvan Library.

entities.name: Kei Takahashi
entities.description: Apprentice healer mutated by Arien.

entities.name: Wasitora
entities.description: Nekoru ally of Umezawa.

entities.name: Lady Orca
entities.description: Overdark's siege demon.

entities.name: Marhault Elsdragon
entities.description: General ordered to invade the Edemis, assassinated by Hage.

entities.name: Jorgan Hage
entities.description: Aerathi Berserker corrupted by Overdark who assassinated Elsdragon.

entities.name: Halfdane
entities.description: Shapeshifter who poisoned the Edemis' mana.

entities.name: Kolo Meha
entities.description: Bogardan seismic mage who aided Umezawa.

entities.name: Imperial Shrine
entities.description: Imperial stronghold destroyed by a Meteor Hammer.

entities.name: Sekana
entities.description: Village where Umezawa's allies gathered after the war.

entities.name: Kusho
entities.description: Edemi island devastated by Lady Orca and later liberated.

events.summary: Overdark launches an aggressive campaign against the Edemi Islands with the Emperor's approval.
events.quote: launched an aggressive campaign against the islands

events.summary: Overdark sends Xira Arien to target Umezawa, who is drawn in after defending Sekana from Wasitora.
events.quote: Overdark dispatching his minion, the eumidian Xira Arien

events.summary: Umezawa is misled into fighting Edemi champions and is imprisoned by Ohabi Caleria.
Umezawa defeats Lady Orca, escapes imprisonment and stabilizes Kei in the Meditation Plane.
events.quote: Umezawa ultimately managed to defeat Lady Orca

events.summary: The Emperor orders Elsdragon to invade the Edemis; Hage assassinates Elsdragon and seizes command.
events.quote: Hage, now under Overdark’s control, took advantage of the chaos to assassinate Elsdragon

events.summary: Umezawa renounces his title and vows to overthrow Overdark and the Emperor; the Emperor paralyzes Overdark.
events.quote: renounced his title and vowed to overthrow both Overdark and the Emperor

events.summary: Ayesha Tanaka leads a counterattack that destroys much of the Madaran fleet and liberates Kusho.
Umezawa kills Xira Arien and Jorgan Hage, storms the Imperial Shrine and decapitates Overdark, absorbing his power.
events.quote: Umezawa decapitated the assassin and absorbed his magical power

events.summary: Umezawa destroys the shrine and defeats the Emperor, revealed as Nicol Bolas, in the Meditation Plane.
events.quote: Umezawa overpowered the dragon and seemingly destroyed him

events.summary: The Madaran Empire collapses and Umezawa chooses to be champion of the land.
events.quote: Umezawa chose to serve as the champion of the land itself

relations.quote: acting with the approval of the enigmatic Emperor of Madara
Overdark dispatching his minion, the eumidian Xira Arien

relations.note: revealed to be the same being
relations.quote: revealed to be the ancient Elder Dragon Nicol Bolas
